notes: Algeria held parliamentary elections on July 2, 2026 with historically low turnout of 21.24%. The ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) won 90 out of 407 seats, followed by RND and independents. Results announced July 6, 2026.

Referendum declared INVALID. Turnout 16.1% (required 50%). Two questions: (1) Cancel lifelong payments for PM Fico and leaders, 95% voted Yes; (2) Reopen Special Prosecutor Office and NAKA, 94% voted Yes. Organized by Democrats party after 350,000+ petition signatures. Fico SMER coalition boycotted. Only 1 of 10 referendums in Slovakia history (2003 EU membership) ever reached validity threshold. 99.98% of votes counted.

RESULT (Jul 20): Carlos Vila Nova wins second term with 55%+ of vote (preliminary). Nito D'Abreu (ADI) received 41%+. No runoff needed. Vila Nova ran as independent after split with ADI. EU Election Observation Mission deployed. 142,296 registered voters.

Parliament dissolved June 25 by King's Representative Sir Tom Marsters on PM's advice. 24 seats, first-past-the-post. Voter registration deadline approaching. Self-governing territory in free association with New Zealand. Sources: RNZ, PINA, Cook Islands News

14 presidential candidates confirmed by ECZ (June 29). Electoral reforms added 70 new parliamentary seats. Campaign schedule adopted. Key issues: jobs, cost of living, critical minerals, democratic concerns. PF joined UPND alliance (no PF on ballot per reports). Sources: ISS Africa, DW, ECZ, Mail & Guardian

SNAP ELECTION called July 1 by President Tokayev decree. First election under new Kurultai system. Ruling Amanat party renamed to Adilet in June 2026 merger with Asar. 98 Mazhilis seats + 69 maslikhat seats. Expected Adilet supermajority. Sources: Reuters, Astana Times, Times of Central Asia
